newsitem.title: FRANCE: French watchdog starts FM frequency tender, audit.
newsitem.headline: French watchdog starts FM frequency tender, audit.

text.p: The Conseil Superieur de l'Audiovisuel (CSA), France's broadcasting regulator, said on Thursday it launched the process of auditing France's FM band signalled at the start of this year.
It said in a statement that prospective candidates for the extra wavelengths it plans to allocate would have to apply by September 4.
The CSA said it plans to publish notice of the tender offer in the European Community's Official Journal.
The audit, set by the CSA and the culture ministry, "responds to a strong desire from radio operators," the CSA said.
The first phase of the audit will involve examining closely the use of the FM band in the Rhone-Alps region, which could be undertaken this autumn, it said.
The CSA said it could spend a million francs on the audit this year. DT/SLA
